themes.title: Energy Policy as Political Battleground
themes.blurb: Right‑wing parties and leaders in the United States, Italy and Norway are foregrounding energy issues as a core political fight, pushing to roll back renewable projects, demand greater national control over power sources, and promote nuclear options as a counter to EU or green‑policy constraints.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration seeks to rescind approval for Connecticut's Revolution Wind offshore project.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni urges the EU to boost energy investments and cut bureaucracy, framing energy sovereignty as a national priority.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Norwegian Progress Party demands immediate nuclear power regulations to expand future energy options.
